name: NCW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Announced on air 18 March 1997 alongside three sister belts, left vacant until the fed's own inaugural supercard crowned "The King of Desire" Ray Kinge -- the wrestler this fed also carried to #105 in the 1997 RSPWF Top 200.

name: NCW World Women's Championship
epitaph: Announced on air 18 March 1997, the only one of the fed's four inaugural belts closed to men; left vacant until Lupa won it at the fed's own first supercard.

name: NCW World Internet Championship
epitaph: One of the fed's own four inaugural titles, open to the whole roster regardless of division or sex; "Violent" Victor Frost won it first, at the fed's own inaugural supercard.

name: NCW World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Announced on air 18 March 1997; won by Bad Company at the fed's own first supercard, in a match its beaten opponents ended by handing the belts over themselves.
